dialogues.speaker: Debal
dialogues.text: What? I'm running a legitimate business here. I don't steal, I don't rob, and I sure don't dupe others out of their fortunes. I work hard and I've earned everything I have through sweat and toil.

dialogues.speaker: Debal
dialogues.text: There aren't many honest folks like me these days, who earn their living through blood, sweat, and tears.

dialogues.speaker: Debal
dialogues.text: Why, if everyone in the Court of Fontaine was like me, fairness and justice would prevail in all business dealings.
